validity.recommendation: Re-examine LengthKnown=170 km. Two independent sources put the EWPS-6->EWPS-8 corridor (MGS III Package 7) at 340 km comprising two PARALLEL 56-in lines (EWGP-3 / EWGP-4). Parallel lines share the same route, so each line is ~340 km long; GEM appears to have set each of its two rows (P6725 'pipeline 3' and P6726 'pipeline 4') to 340/2 = 170 km, which mis-models corridor length as a per-line sum. Verify whether the intended LengthKnown for this single parallel line should be ~340 km (then drop one of the two rows or keep both at 340 with a clear twin-line note), or confirm with Aramco route data if 170 km is a deliberate sub-segment split.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Confirmed real. MGS III (Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3) is a well-documented ~USD 18bn Aramco program adding ~4,000-4,153 km of new gas pipelines + 17 compression trains, +3.15-3.2 bscfd, construction commenced Q2 2024, completion Q4 2028. Independently documented by MEED, BlackRidge Research, OGN News, and Pipeline Technology Journal (L&T completing a major section). Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: Correct. This is dry natural-gas TRANSMISSION (east-west trunk lines, 56-inch, feeding Aramco's national gas grid) per MEED ('east-west gas pipelines') and BlackRidge. Not NGL, not gathering. Owner Aramco 100% confirmed. Status 'construction' consistent with Q2 2024 start / Q4 2028 completion. Diameter 56 in confirmed by both MEED and BlackRidge. DUPLICATE check: P6726 ('EWPS-6-EWPS-8 "4"') and P6725 ('EWPS-6-EWPS-8 "3"') correspond to MEED's 'east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-6 to EWPS-8' and BlackRidge's 'EWGP-3 and EWGP-4'. These are TWO genuinely PARALLEL pipelines along the same corridor, so P6725 and P6726 are NOT a relabel/double-count of one pipe -- keeping two rows is defensible. The defect is the LENGTH, not the row count. SPEC: MEED ('Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-6 to EWPS-8, covering 340km') and BlackRidge ('Lay 56-inch diameter pipelines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4) from EWPS-6 to EWPS-8 (340km)') both give 340 km for the corridor. GEM's two rows each at 170 km sum to 340, indicating the corridor length was halved across the two parallel lines -- but parallel lines do not split distance; each line runs the full ~340 km route. Hence the 170 km value materially disagrees with the corroborated 340 km route length. Capacity left blank (no per-line figure available; program-level 3.15-3.2 bscfd is not attributable to one segment -- correctly left blank). Start year 2028 (operational/completion) corroborated by BlackRidge ('Q4 2028') and OGN ('4Q-2028'), independent of GEM.
